description: Build a trader-oriented FX pair setup using spot context, macro differentials, upcoming catalyst risk, and optional COT positioning. Set view for pair context only or a ranked event-risk score. Access: API key required, else returns subscription_required with a subscribe link.

base.description: Base currency, 3-letter ISO code. Supported: lowercase 3-letter catalogue currency, e.g. usd or eur.

end_date.description: view='pair_intel' only: inclusive upper bound, YYYY-MM-DD.

horizon_events.description: Maximum upcoming catalysts per leg to rank. Defaults to 4, or 6 for view='release_risk'.

include_cot.description: When true, attempt to include COT positioning context for both legs.

quote.description: Quote currency, 3-letter ISO code. Supported: lowercase 3-letter catalogue currency, e.g. usd or eur.

start_date.description: view='pair_intel' only: inclusive lower bound, YYYY-MM-DD.

view.description: setup (default) builds the full trade setup. pair_intel returns spot, carry and policy-differential context. release_risk ranks upcoming event risk for the pair.

name: fx_trade_setup_task
title: FX Trade Setup Analysis
